leaders.name: Narendra Modi
leaders.title: Prime Minister of India
leaders.content: Shri Narendra Modi Ji, born on September 17, 1950, in Vadnagar, Gujarat, has made a profound impact on India and the world as the Prime Minister since 2014. Growing up in a modest family, Modi's early experiences instilled in him a strong sense of determination and service. He joined the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) at a young age, which laid the foundation for his political career Under Modi's leadership, India has seen significant economic reforms aimed at boosting growth and enhancing global competitiveness. The 'Make in India' initiative has revitalized the manufacturing sector, attracting foreign investment and generating employment. His 'Digital India' campaign has transformed the country into a tech-savvy nation, expanding internet access and digital literacy among citizens Modi is also known for his emphasis on sanitation and hygiene through the 'Swachh Bharat Abhiyan,' which has mobilized millions to participate in cleanliness drives across the country. His commitment to renewable energy is exemplified by the International Solar Alliance, which fosters global cooperation on solar energy deployment.
